notes.text: 2026-08-21: run_cells.py aborted the interpreter on Kelly's Mac at 7c_penguins-key.qmd cell 14. The cell calls plt.show(), macOS defaults matplotlib to the macosx backend, and starting a GUI event loop inside the checker process crashes it. Quarto is unaffected, since it renders through a Jupyter kernel on the inline backend, and that page rendered cleanly at step 6 of 89. The backend is now pinned to Agg inside run_cells.py itself rather than left to the caller's environment, and tools/_env.sh exports it for the other scripts. Verified on Linux, where the default was already Agg; the fix targets the macOS default specifically.
